Style Family + Style Theme (T0-T8) (#223)

* Add Style Family and Style Theme platform model (T0-T8).

Introduce avr_style_families/themes tables with import auto-upsert, management APIs, release styleThemes payload, runtime manifest delivery, CEL theme.*, Swan Theme wrapping, and Robin style families UI.

* Fix style theme runtime isolation and family consistency.

Drop cross-tenant compiled_payload fallback, upsert families on manual style create, and enforce optimistic revision locking on theme updates.
